description: Darkspyre's source-compatible Microsoft.ML.Tokenizers fork with corrected SentencePiece optional-token handling.
Foundational abstractions, primitives, and shared utilities

Unofficial fork of zxing-cpp 3.1.1 / ZXingCpp 0.5.3: adds linear barcode detection at arbitrary rotation angles (plus/minus 45 degrees) with sub-pixel scan line sampling. Managed layer ships the enhanced helpers used in the demo: BarcodeScanner, ScanResult, BarcodeInfo, and Barcode.Rotation/Orienta…
REST/JSON and JSON-file data provider for ReportWright reports, with an element path selecting the row collection and a host allowlist. Server-side only.

Designer-side model services over the DocWright report definition: reversible commands and the undo stack over the element tree, item descriptors and the item registry, palette and property-grid metadata. Runs under Blazor WebAssembly.
The ReportWright report designer component for Blazor WebAssembly: design surface, palette, property grid, expression editor and live preview, over ReportWright.Design.
Shared Blazor chrome for the ReportWright viewer and designer: the inline SVG icon sprite, theme tokens, localisation resources and the parameter bar.
Bridges System.Data (DataTable, DataSet, IDataReader) to ReportWright reports as a data provider. Server-side only; kept out of the engine, which excludes System.Data.
The ReportWright report viewer component for Blazor WebAssembly and Blazor Server, over the DocWright.Reporting.Viewer projection and services.

ASP.NET Core host for ReportWright: MapReportWright endpoints for report load and save, parameters, rendering, toggles, sort, search and export; IReportStore and IReportPermissions; the export-format registry; host resolver registration.
Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL data provider for ReportWright reports: parameterised commands over Microsoft.Data.SqlClient, schema discovery, connection test. Server-side only.
CSV and delimited-file data provider for ReportWright reports, with type inference. Server-side only.

The data-source seam ReportWright providers implement: connect, test and discover schema, host-held credentials, field metadata. Execution itself is DocWright.Reporting's ReportDataProvider. Runs under Blazor WebAssembly.

XML data provider for ReportWright reports: the XmlData a report embeds in its own query, which is how Report Builder's sample reports carry their data. XML files and services arrive in a later phase.
